`nvOpticalFlowCommon.h` is from NVIDIA's Optical Flow SDK
(https://github.com/NVIDIA/NVIDIAOpticalFlowSDK), BSD 3-clause license (see the header).
The optical flow library itself (nvofapi64.dll) and CUDA (nvcuda.dll) ship with the NVIDIA
display driver and are loaded at runtime; nothing from NVIDIA is redistributed in binary form.
